scope.excluded_work: all catalog problems and research tracks other than #021/B7, #022/B2, and #023

question: Can a source-bound Stim/PyMatching experiment directly reproduce both X and Z logical memory at 1,000 rounds without promoting simulator evidence into a scalable-memory or hardware claim?

toolchain_contract.decoder: PyMatching MWPM built from Stim detector error model with decompose_errors=true
toolchain_contract.sampling: Stim compiled detector sampler with explicit per-configuration seed, 256-shot chunks, and bit-packed detector/observable output
toolchain_contract.reproducibility_boundary: trace hashes are bound to the frozen versions, seeds, chunking, and execution architecture; they are not promised portable across a changed Stim build, SIMD path, or chunk schedule

experiment_contract.confidence_method: two-sided Wilson 95 percent interval with z=1.959963984540054
experiment_contract.basis_pair_rule: X and Z must independently clear the same total-failure target at identical distance, rounds, shots, physical-error parameters, decoder family, and toolchain
experiment_contract.direct_evidence_rule: every accepted row must execute exactly 1,000 correction rounds; no shorter-row projection is accepted

trace_binding.circuit_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical Stim circuit text
trace_binding.detector_error_model_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical decomposed Stim detector-error-model text
trace_binding.sample_prediction_trace_sha256: SHA-256 over ordered chunk headers and bit-packed detector, observable, and decoder-prediction bytes
trace_binding.failure_vector_sha256: SHA-256 over ordered per-shot logical-failure bits
trace_binding.chunk_digest_manifest: one SHA-256 digest per frozen shot chunk, including offset, shapes, detectors, observables, and predictions
trace_binding.raw_trace_boundary: hash-bound aggregate evidence permits exact same-environment rerun comparison but does not substitute for a public raw hardware trace dataset

acceptance_gate.direct_1k_staging_pass: at least one distance passes both X and Z Wilson upper bounds at the 1 percent total logical-failure target
acceptance_gate.p023_reason: the previously frozen scalable-memory gate also requires direct one-million-round evidence, decoder timing, and drift/correlation stress
acceptance_gate.b2_reason: no same-condition candidate-code versus surface-code physical-qubit-cycle comparison is performed
acceptance_gate.b7_reason: the one-million-round, calibrated-evidence, and candidate-overhead gates remain closed
